reply.text:
Nothing's actually logged for squat yet in your history, so I can't point to a specific sticking point or number for you. If you tell me roughly where it's stalling — a weight you can't move past, or whether it's strength or form breaking down at the bottom, mid-rise, or lockout — I can give you real advice instead of generic stuff.

In general: plateaus usually break with one of three things — more volume at a slightly lighter weight for a few weeks, a pause or tempo variation to fix a weak spot, or just a deload and fresh run at it. If you want, I can build that into your program as a block aimed at the squat.
